verdict.headline: Long-term Treasury yields climb past their 2002 highs overnight as chip stocks hold up futures
verdict.label: Pre-market: S&P 500 futures +0.3%, Nasdaq-100 futures +0.6%, Dow futures +0.2% after a three-month low; 10Y ~5.30% (high ~5.32%), 30Y ~5.64% (high ~5.66%); Oct hike odds ~37%; Brent (Dec) $100.15; gold ~$4,205; BTC ~$83,970.
verdict.rationale_short: The thirty-year Treasury yield traded at about 5.66% overnight, above its 2002 high of 5.644%, and the ten-year reached about 5.32%, both the highest since 2002, the day after Treasuries' worst quarter since 1994. October hike odds have fallen to about 37% from more than 70% a week ago, so the rise is coming from inflation, debt and supply worries rather than the expected Fed path. European stocks fell 1% and Dow futures touched a three-month low, but Micron's results and Google's Gemini 4 Argon launch lifted chip and AI names and Nasdaq-100 futures 0.6%. The thirty-year is back near 5.64%, so today's close decides whether the break holds; a close back under 5.60% would make the overnight high look like a spike.
verdict.lede_short: The 30-year Treasury yield moved above its 2002 high overnight and the 10-year reached its highest since 2002, even as October rate-hike odds fell to about 37%, which points to inflation and debt worries rather than the Fed. Chip and AI stocks are holding Nasdaq futures up while European stocks and Dow futures fell. The 30-year is back at the line, so today's close decides it; a close under 5.60% would make the overnight high look like a spike.

supporting_data.label: Ten-year and thirty-year yields hit 5.32% and 5.66%, the highest since 2002, a day after Treasuries' worst quarter since 1994 — the thirty-year moved past the 5.644% level that marked its 2002 high.
October hike odds fell to about 37% from more than 70% a week ago while long yields kept rising — the pressure on the long end is not coming from the expected Fed path.
Brent rose back above $100, up 2.2% to $100.15, after a report that Chinese refiners suspended October fuel exports — the oil-driven inflation worry behind long yields gained support before the open.
The STOXX 600 fell 1% to 628.1, its lowest since mid-September, with banks leading — the bond selloff is global, not a US reaction to one data print.
S&P 500 futures rose 0.3% and Nasdaq-100 futures 0.6%, with Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom higher after Micron's results — chip stocks are rising against higher rates while the rest of the market is not.
Google launched Gemini 4 Argon with a record 77.9% on the DeepSWE v1.1 coding benchmark, and Alphabet rose about 2% before the open — a second AI catalyst on top of Micron.

watchlist_mentions.note: About 1% lower pre-market despite the beat and $61.5 billion guide; customer supply commitments rose to $32 billion, but the company flagged slightly softer margins this quarter and higher fiscal 2027 operating costs. Peers rose on the results.
Up about 2% pre-market after launching Gemini 4 Argon, which scored a record 77.9% on DeepSWE v1.1; access starts with cybersecurity researchers and paying customers.
Higher pre-market with AMD and Broadcom as Micron's results lifted the chip group.

trade_setups.thesis: The thirty-year traded at about 5.66% overnight, above its 2002 high of 5.644%, and is back near 5.64%; the first close above the line has not yet happened.
trade_setups.invalidation: A close above 5.644% would put long yields at levels last seen in 2001; a close under 5.60% would make the overnight high look like a spike rather than a new range.

trade_setups.thesis: Forecasts near 54.8 against 54.6, with one at 55.5 led by new orders; Wednesday's upward growth revisions lifted long yields more than soft inflation lowered them.
trade_setups.entry: Consensus 54.8; upper forecast 55.5; initial claims expected near 201,000.
trade_setups.invalidation: Above 55.5 adds to the growth case behind long yields; under 54 tests whether weak data can lower long yields at all.

trade_setups.thesis: Nasdaq-100 futures are up twice as much as S&P 500 futures while Dow futures touched a three-month low; chip stocks are rising against higher discount rates on Micron's results.
trade_setups.entry: Ten-year ~5.30% against the 5.34% overnight high; Micron near $1,060 against $1,000.
trade_setups.invalidation: A ten-year above 5.34% or Micron below $1,000 would test whether the chip group can keep separating from rates.
